comment: positive: a variable named like an unreserved keyword is a valid assignment target
body: DECLARE forward int := 21; BEGIN forward := forward * 2; END

comment: positive: a bound cursor FOR loop is accepted (reads as a query FOR)
body: DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT 1; BEGIN FOR r IN c LOOP END LOOP; END

comment: negative: assignment to a CONSTANT variable is rejected
body: DECLARE x CONSTANT int := 1; BEGIN x := 2; END

comment: negative: assignment to a field of a CONSTANT is rejected via the parent
body: DECLARE x CONSTANT int[] := '{1}'; BEGIN x[1] := 2; END

comment: negative: CONTINUE outside a loop is rejected
error: CONTINUE cannot be used outside a loop

comment: negative: unlabeled EXIT outside a loop is rejected
error: EXIT cannot be used outside a loop, unless it has a label

comment: negative: EXIT referencing a nonexistent label is rejected
body: BEGIN LOOP EXIT no_such_label; END LOOP; END

comment: negative: CONTINUE targeting a block label is rejected
body: BEGIN <<blk>> BEGIN LOOP CONTINUE blk; END LOOP; END; END
error: block label "blk" cannot be used in CONTINUE

comment: negative: a cursor FOR loop over an unbound cursor is rejected
body: DECLARE c refcursor; BEGIN FOR r IN c LOOP END LOOP; END
error: cursor FOR loop must use a bound cursor variable
